title: Just OK
text: Just OK. It's what I wanted but you can't really see that its a giraffe with 2 or 3 rolls on.  I think it would be nicer if it were taller and had some color variation maybe highlighting the giraffe's spots.  Sort of looks like a iron rod with toilet paper over it. I think I will guild some of the spots and face to highlight.  But it is a Cute idea though.  It would make a nice unique gift and would be fine for a guest bathroom.
